Bharath Lokireddy
B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2015
4
3Placements5Infrastructure4Faculty4Crowd & Campus Life4Value for Money
Other: IIT Bombay is the best college if you want to pursue a career in engineering. It has a wide range of disciplines which is a must to go through, after you qualify the JEE advanced in order to give your branch and institute preferences in accordance with your interests. The institute is itself a separate world with its huge 550 acres of green campus which has two lakes and a hill. The campus provides an awesome range of facilities and infrastructure for sports and fitness. Firstly coming to academics, there won’t be any pressure on the students like the intermediate which is a huge positive point to enjoy the campus life and to take the decisions which could affect the life, topics are taught by the experienced faculty for a classroom of around 200 with 2 projectors, the questions for the exams would come from the syllabus taught, understanding everything taught by the professors is the key to score good grades. The grading system is relative which means even if the paper is tough you won’t lose your good grades. Now coming to extracurricular activities, there are a wide range of clubs which encourage you to take part in them, ranging from racing car team to a skating club, there will be round the year events for cultural activities, sports, arts. Seniors will be there to guide you with anything you want to learn. The famous Mood Indigo and Tech Fest of IIT Bombay are completely managed by students, which is the range you could achieve if you utilize the opportunities in-front of you perfectly.

Other: It is the best college in India. People assume that IITs is all about studies, but the scene is completely different here. Every student has an opportunity to explore himself in every possible direction and the best part is that it does not require any support from faculties or staff. The students are given freedom to look for opportunities and get indulged in them as per their interest. This freedom has led to a startup-boom in past few years and 1 out of 10 people give a try on entrepreneurship in some way or the other. Placements do not only include core technical companies but is flooded with MNCs of Finance and Consults like DB, BCG etc. Life is cool and as the campus lies in the heart of the city, even traveling and trekking becomes people’s hobby.
